description: The two pie charts compare the relative frequencies of certain tokens co-occurring with the word "reaction" in the domains of chemistry and mathematics. Chart (a) has five slices, with "the" in blue diagonal stripes making up 31%, "this" in horizontal blue stripes making up 21%, "for" in a green crisscross pattern making up 17%, "chemical" in yellow texture making up 15%, and "in" in blue vertical stripes making up 7% or 9%. The chart includes a legend that matches the labels to their corresponding colors and patterns, and percentage labels are placed directly on the slices. Chart (b) has four slices, with "the" in blue diagonal stripes making up 38%, an unspecified token "$" in red dots making up 27%, "equilibrium" in yellow dots making up 19%, and "constant" in grey making up 15%. A legend is provided to match the labels to their corresponding colors and patterns, and the percentage labels are placed directly on the slices. The slices in both charts are arranged in a particular order, with the largest slice first, but no slices are visually emphasized.
